title: Gas Pay
tagline: Gas pay will enable to pay gas in any token & NFT while using any Dex.
description: This project is about gas fees, If you are using any swap ex: Uniswap, Raydium, Pancake then you have to give fees in Ethereum, Solana & BNB their particular coin. If you want to give fees in any other token or NFT you will able to give using Gas-Pay. NFT feature will be in testing phase.
how_its_made: This project will use to give their gas fees in any token. It is made using JavaScript, Solidity, Node Js, React,  etc... We will use NFT port API for the NFT to pay in fees. Our API will easily integrate in any swap are available currently. The price of NFT will fix for some NFT and for some it may be dynamic price.
